intro: Maple Grove School's comms cupboard, wired from the scan: the router, the Wi-Fi welcome page server and six wall sockets. The guesses came from 10.10.0.66, a laptop that isn't on the network now. This first work order teaches the bench: click a device, a port or a socket.

tasks.text: Lock the rack in the comms cupboard
tasks.hint: Use the rack lock on the bench, or in the Server room.

tasks.text: Shut the six wall sockets nobody uses (D1 to D6)
tasks.hint: Click sw1 and pick ports 3 to 8, or click each socket. A shut port stays dead even if someone plugs a laptop in.

tasks.text: The welcome page still works: wifi reaches the router and the internet
